title: Connections Between CGLMP Inequalities and Quantum Field Theory
exact_target: Explain the mathematical link between CGLMP Bell inequalities and the quantum Fourier transform used in the optimal measurements.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000179 (OWR-785-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Entanglement and Decoherence: Mathematics and Physics of Quantum Information and Computation (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/04, pp. 185--255; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 28, printed page 212.
Collins et al., Bell inequalities for arbitrarily high-dimensional systems; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The catalogue title and clean statement expand QFT as quantum field theory. The primary report explicitly discusses the Quantum Fourier Transform immediately before asking for the CGLMP--QFT link. Thus the source-context question concerns the Fourier transform; no quantum-field-theory connection is asserted here. The catalogue wording is preserved below to make this discrepancy visible.
